jobs_results.title: Python Developer  in Bangalore  AI & Web Applications
jobs_results.job_title: Python Developer  in Bangalore  AI & Web Applications
jobs_results.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a skilled Python Developer with 23 years of hands-on experience in developing dynamic web applications, REST APIs, AI-integrated applications, and automation solutions.


The ideal candidate should have strong Python fundamentals, practical experience with modern Python frameworks, and the ability to integrate AI/ML models, LLMs, databases, and third-party services into real-world web applications.


What We Do
Nextwebi is an AI-enabled digital transformation and software development company. We design and develop:



Custom web applications and enterprise portals
AI-powered applications, chatbots, and automation solutions
REST APIs and third-party system integrations
Data-driven dashboards and business applications
SaaS products and scalable cloud-based platforms
Machine learning and intelligent document-processing solutions
AI knowledge bases and RAG-based applications

What Youll Be Doing

Develop dynamic, secure, and scalable web applications using Python.
Design, develop, document, and maintain REST APIs.
Build backend applications using Django, Django REST Framework (DRF), Flask, or FastAPI.
Integrate AI models, LLMs, and machine learning services into web applications.
Work with APIs and services from OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock, and other AI platforms.
Develop AI-powered chatbots, knowledge-base applications, document-processing systems, recommendation systems, and automation tools.
Build and integrate Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows.
Implement authentication, authorization, data validation, logging, exception handling, and application security.
Work with frontend developers to integrate Python APIs with React.js and Next.js applications.
Design and manage databases, data models, and application workflows.
Write clean, reusable, secure, testable, and well-documented code.
Use AI-assisted coding tools to improve development speed, debugging, testing, and code quality.
Deploy and maintain Python applications on cloud platforms.
Troubleshoot production issues and optimize application performance.

Required Technical Skills

Strong knowledge of Python and object-oriented programming.
Hands-on experience with Django, Django REST Framework (DRF), Flask, or FastAPI.
Good understanding of REST API development and third-party API integration.
Experience working with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or SQL Server.
Understanding of database design, queries, indexing, and ORM concepts.
Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern web application architecture.
Familiarity with Git, GitHub/GitLab, Postman, Docker, and CI/CD.
Understanding of authentication and authorization methods such as JWT and OAuth.
Basic knowledge of AWS, Azure, or other cloud platforms.
Ability to write unit tests, debug applications, and troubleshoot complex technical issues.

Python Libraries & AI/ML Technologies
Candidates should have experience with, or a good practical understanding of, relevant technologies such as:



Web Development: Django, Django REST Framework, Flask, FastAPI, Pydantic
Data Processing: Pandas, NumPy, OpenPyXL
AI & Machine Learning: Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch
Generative AI: OpenAI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers
Vector Databases: Qdrant, Pinecone, Chroma, FAISS
Document Processing: PyPDF2, pdfplumber, BeautifulSoup, OCR tools
Database & ORM: SQLAlchemy, Django ORM
Testing: Pytest, Unittest
Automation: Selenium, Playwright, Requests
Background Processing: Celery, Redis
Deployment: Docker, Nginx, Gunicorn, Uvicorn

Experience with every library listed above is not mandatory. Candidates should have strong practical knowledge of the technologies relevant to their previous projects and be comfortable learning new frameworks and tools.


AI/ML Experience
The candidate should understand how to:



Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) through APIs.
Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications.
Generate, manage, and store embeddings using vector databases.
Work with prompt engineering and structured AI outputs.
Build AI chatbots, copilots, and knowledge-base applications.
Process and extract information from PDFs, documents, and websites.
Develop basic machine learning models and data-processing workflows.
Integrate AI functionality into existing web applications and APIs.
Manage AI API costs, response times, data privacy, security, and error handling.

Candidate Profile

23 years of professional Python development experience.
Experience developing and deploying real-world web applications.
Strong problem-solving and logical-thinking abilities.
Good understanding of secure and scalable application development.
Ability to work independently and collaborate with frontend, QA, DevOps, and project teams.
Willingness to learn new AI technologies, frameworks, and development tools.
Good written and verbal communication skills.

Good to Have

Experience with microservices and asynchronous .
